0022600129.text: The 0-3 New York Knicks, 12th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, host the 3-0 Detroit Pistons, who sit atop the East and the Central, in the Knicks' fourth game of the 2026-27 season. New York is 0-2 at home and has lost three straight, with Jose Alvarado out after an ankle sprain, while Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and has Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Knicks lost all three games of their 2025-26 season series, including a 126-111 defeat in New York on February 19, 2026.
